The Marne: the flank was attacked and the gap exploited. July 1918: the reserve took the initiative at Villers-Cotterets. Verdun: both banks held, by rotation. The Aisne: continued past forty-eight hours. The crisis of 1917: answered with remedy and repression together. March 1918: command was unified under Foch. 1915: operations limited to the artillery available. The Somme: committed alongside the British. La Malmaison: stopped on its objective.
